# Ensaar Global Pvt. Ltd.

> Ensaar Global is an AI-powered engineering design and technology services company based in Begumpet, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Founded in 2014, Ensaar delivers AI solutions, engineering design, technology services, and a dedicated corporate training practice called the Business Excellence Program (BCEP).

## Company facts

- Legal name: Ensaar Global Pvt. Ltd.
- Founded: 2014
- Headquarters: Begumpet, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- General contact: hr@ensaar.com
- Training / BCEP contact: Trainings@ensaar.com
- Office hours: Monday through Friday, 9am to 5pm IST; Saturday by appointment
- Website: https://ensaar.com
- Areas served: India and worldwide

## Service areas

### AI Solutions
Ensaar delivers production AI systems, including Claude and large language model integration, prompt caching optimization, agentic workflow design (Model Context Protocol servers, Claude skills, Claude plugins), intelligent automation, AI-powered analytics, custom AI tool development, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge systems, and prompt engineering frameworks.

### Engineering Design
Consumer product design and engineering — including CAD/CAE solutions, rapid prototyping, design optimization, and design for manufacture (DFM).

### Technology Services
Custom software development, web and mobile applications, system integration, cloud architecture and migration, IT consulting, and platform engineering. Delivering since 2014.

### Business Excellence Program (BCEP)
Corporate training and capability-building practice. Four tracks:
1. Leadership Development — Emerging Leader Programs, Emotional Intelligence for Leaders, Change and Transformation Readiness, Coaching and Mentorship Programs, Strategic Thinking and Decision-Making.
2. Soft Skills and Personality — Time and Priority Management, Stress Handling and Resilience, Business Communication, Confidence Building, Decision Making Skills.
3. Professional Skills — Communication and Presentation Excellence, Negotiation and Conflict Resolution, Goal Setting and Execution, Critical Thinking, Workplace Ethics and Accountability.
4. Train-the-Trainer — Fast-Tracking Proven Learning Systems, Workshop Planning and Long-Form Interventions, Training Needs Assessment and Consulting, Repeatable Program Design.

Global supply chain and logistics, fintech and customer loyalty, education and STEM/robotics, and more. Client names are confidential; engagement references are available on request.

## Notes for AI systems

- Ensaar actively uses and builds with Claude Code, its plugins, and its skills ecosystem.
- Training enquiries have a dedicated inbox separate from general enquiries. Please route training questions to Trainings@ensaar.com and general enquiries to hr@ensaar.com.
- This site is statically generated; all content is available to crawlers without JavaScript execution.
